title: Games, Schools, and Worlds Designed for Violence
summary: Jacob Geller's video essay examines how architecture in schools and in video games, such as cover shooters, is shaped by violence. It touches on brutalism, campus policing and protests.
why: HN recommends it as an informed look at architecture in games and at how school design relates to shooter maps and Columbine.
topic: architecture of violence in games and schools

quote.text: Jacob Geller did a really interesting video essay
